crossRefs.note: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

people.name: Eliashib
people.line: High priest, father of Joiada and ancestor of Jaddua

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A high priest during the Persian period

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
translations.bsb: As for the descendants of Levi, the family heads up to the days of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles.
translations.kjv: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
translations.asv: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers' houses, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
